name: Saitou Tamaki
source:
A psychiatrist at the hospital owned by the Kuchiki family.

[spoiler]His real name is Rokushiki Makoto. He committed a string of serial murders in 1950, in which Reiji's fiancee was one of the victims.[/spoiler]
